summary: Full-stack testing of 'All My Meals' completed. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed against public URL, covering household create/join/get, recipe LLM import from pasted text, recipe list/search/category filters, recipe soft delete, meal plan CRUD, grocery CRUD, grocery-from-recipe and clear-completed. Frontend: end-to-end Playwright walkthrough at 390x844 covered onboarding (welcome->create->name->start), library rendering + search + category chips, LLM recipe import producing full structured recipe (title, description, macros, ingredients, steps) navigating to detail screen, add-to-grocery (added 4-5 items), open-plan-sheet + confirm-add-plan flow, Planner tab (add-slot picker + pick-recipe + plan-entry + remove-plan), Grocery tab (add item, toggle, clear completed), and Kitchen tab (6-char share code + copy/share/leave). No red-screen errors observed. Only console warnings are cosmetic deprecations (shadow* and pointerEvents props).

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic, from third-party styles; consider migrating.

action_items: Optional: silence deprecated style warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) to keep console clean.
Optional: HouseholdCreate has member_name with no min length; empty string falls back to 'Me'. Consider Pydantic min_length validation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py properly excludes MongoDB _id in all responses (find with {'_id':0} and pop after insert_one).
All routes namespaced under /api and env vars used correctly (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY).
LLM extractor sanitizes category/aisle/ints/servings; falls back to placeholder image if none. Robust for text/URL inputs.
Soft delete pattern used consistently (deleted_at) for recipes, mealplan, grocery.
server.py is 517 lines; acceptable but nearing threshold - future split into routers (households/recipes/mealplan/grocery/llm) recommended.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, testIDs are present on all interactive elements including category-chip-*, recipe-card-*.
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_ created via pytest (households, recipes, grocery, mealplan). LLM-generated recipes such as 'Simple Garlic Butter Pasta' and 'Quick Tomato Soup' were created during frontend flow tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MVP is stable. Public URL: https://recipe-saver-56.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. LLM recipe import takes ~5-15s; frontend polls navigation to /recipe/[id] on success. To seed data quickly, use pasted TEXT (not URLs) for import.
